## Scope

## Risk review

- [ ] Mastery/scheduler behavior is unchanged, or changes are explained and tested.
- [ ] Stored data/schema/import/export is unchanged, or migration/rollback is included.
- [ ] Games still cannot certify or advance mastery.
- [ ] Accessibility and reduced-motion impacts were reviewed.
- [ ] Privacy, permissions, network, and security impacts were reviewed.
- [ ] Scripture/content changes have exact provenance and human review.
- [ ] Licensing/attribution and rights-managed assets were reviewed.

## Documentation and release records

- [ ] Tests/fixtures updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] CHANGELOG and relevant docs updated.
- [ ] Known issues/release gates updated without overstating readiness.
- [ ] No credentials, personal backups, private correspondence, or rights-pending audio included.
